subject: PO requirements, invoice cadence & Net terms for Kestrel engagement
messages:
From: Lisa Barnes <lisa.barnes@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Rishi,

We're ready to move forward with Redwood for the diagnostics pilot, but procurement needs to confirm a few things before we issue a formal PO. Can you confirm the following so we can get this through our approval flow?

- Vendor remit / billing entity and EIN to include on the PO
- Required PO header fields (we generally require: PO number, bill-to BU, GL code, approver id) — will Redwood accept our PO layout?
- Preferred net terms (we typically default to Net45, but can do Net30 for strategic vendors)
- Invoice cadence: Kestrel prefers consolidated monthly invoices per legal entity; however, one of our product groups wants weekly usage statements — is Redwood able to provide a weekly CSV export while invoicing monthly?
- Any minimum invoice amounts or pre-authorization (preauth) needed for usage-based charges?

I've attached our PO template and procurement policy to this email. Can you get back with an initial answer today or tomorrow? We're targeting a PO cut by the 25th to hit the Feb billing cycle.

Thanks,
Lisa Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager
Kestrel Health
[Attachment: Kestrel_PO_Template_v3.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Kestrel_Procurement_Policy.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Barnes <lisa.barnes@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Lisa — thanks for the template and policy, appreciated. Quick answers below and next steps:

- Billing entity / remit: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  EIN: 83-4271983
  Remit address: 180 Middle Ave, San Francisco, CA 94105

- PO header fields: We accept PO number, bill-to legal entity, GL code, approver id and can map your PO number to our internal invoice header. If you require particular XML/EDI formatting we can support a flat CSV mapping for the initial rollout.

- Net terms: Standard for Redwood is Net45. We can offer Net30 under an approved commercial exception for strategic commitments (we usually tie Net30 to a 6–12 month minimum commit or a small early-pay discount). If Kestrel needs strict Net45, that's fine — we can mirror your standard.

- Invoice cadence / weekly statements: We can provide weekly usage exports (CSV) for BU-level reporting while issuing a consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity. That is our recommended approach for usage-driven engagements.

- Preauth / minimums: No mandatory minimum invoice amount, but we do require a PO referencing the account and period for reconciliation. For automated billing we prefer a PO per billing entity; we can accept child PO references for multiple BUs on the monthly invoice.

I've attached a short PO acceptance form that lists the fields we need on your PO to minimize reconciliation mismatches. Vanessa and Ben (cc) are on the billing side and will help with anything EDI/CSV-related.

Next step: If you can return a signed PO next week with the PO number populated and a note that monthly consolidated invoices are acceptable (with weekly CSV exports), we can target activation on Feb 1. If procurement needs an exception (e.g., weekly invoices instead of monthly), flag that now so we can route to Finance.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Acceptance_Form.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Lisa Barnes <lisa.barnes@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@kestrelhealth.com>, CFO <cfo@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Thanks Rishi — that helps. A few clarifications from procurement after reviewing your acceptance form:

1) Our policy requires the vendor to show the PO number on each invoice line. Consolidated monthly invoice is preferred, but each line-item must include the originating PO number. Will Redwood be able to accept and show multiple PO references on a single invoice?

2) Net45 is our baseline. We will not commit to Net30 for this pilot.

3) For the one product group that wants weekly statements: they need a weekly billing lane available to them for reconciliation, but we will still require a single monthly legal-entity invoice for payment. Can Redwood provide weekly CSVs broken down by BU/PO and a monthly consolidated invoice that includes those PO numbers?

4) We cannot accept any invoice-level early-pay fee. That's a firm procurement constraint.

5) Finally, we need a confirmation of the billing contact and a sample of the CSV structure for the weekly export so our ERP team can validate field mapping.

Attached: our formal procurement policy and a draft PO (filled with sample metadata). If these points are OK, I'll route for signature. If the weekly CSV requires an extra integration effort, please outline the estimated lead time.

Best,
Lisa
[Attachment: Kestrel_Procurement_Policy.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Kestrel engagement — negotiation notes

Team — forwarding Kestrel's clarifying points. Summary / proposed approach: 

- We can accept multiple PO references on a single consolidated invoice and will render PO numbers on invoice line items. This will require mapping their child PO numbers to our invoice lines; Ben, can your team map multiple PO fields into the billing export?

- Net45 accepted (no change).

- Weekly CSV exports for the BU: engineering can produce a simple weekly usage CSV (date range, BU, PO number, tokens, charge amount, charge id). We'll provide a sample file and field list to Kestrel this week. Vanessa — can you take point on the sample CSV and include a column mapping to our invoice field names? Attach proposed billing matrix I'm suggesting.

- No early-pay fees — confirm we will not push any early-payment surcharge.

- Risk: if their ERP requires weekly invoices (instead of weekly CSV + monthly invoice), Finance will need to approve the operational overhead. Proposal: accept their requirement conditionally — we support weekly CSV + monthly invoice without fees. If they insist on weekly invoices, require a short SOW for weekly billing handling.

Action items:
- Ben: quick feasibility check on multi-PO line rendering and whether our invoice template can display multiple PO numbers cleanly (ETA EOD Fri).
- Vanessa: produce sample CSV + proposed-billing-matrix.csv and a short note on mapping (ETA: EOD Fri).
- Rishi: I'll respond to Lisa with our proposed acceptance (monthly invoice with PO-line rendering + weekly CSV export) and call out the weekly-invoice SOW fallback.

Thanks,
Rishi

[Attachment: proposed-billing-matrix.csv (csv)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Barnes <lisa.barnes@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood engagement — proposed billing plan

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear constraints. Quick confirmation and proposal so procurement can sign: 

1) Net terms: Redwood accepts Net45 per your policy.

2) Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly invoice per Kestrel legal entity. Each invoice line will include the originating PO number(s) supplied by Kestrel so your ERP can match lines to POs.

3) Weekly statements: Redwood will deliver a weekly CSV export for the BU that requested it. The CSV will contain: week_range, BU, originating_PO, usage_units, unit_price, line_amount, internal_charge_id. Vanessa has created a sample CSV (attached) and Ben confirmed our invoice renderer can show multiple PO references per line.

4) Fees: Redwood will not apply any early-pay or invoice-level fees for this engagement.

5) Operational exception: If Kestrel's ERP absolutely requires separate weekly invoices (rather than weekly CSV + monthly invoice), Redwood can support that as a bill-processing SOW (one-time engineering + Ops cost). We think CSV + monthly invoice will be lower lift for everyone.

Please confirm that is acceptable and, if so, return the PO with the PO number and the note "Monthly consolidated invoice; weekly CSV exported for BU reconciliation". Once we receive the signed PO we'll create the billing mapping and target an activation for Feb 1.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-weekly-usage.csv (csv)]
